messages.text: Reviewer B, I reviewed the proposed values [19, 21] against the limit 20. The value 21 violates the requirement (must be <= 20). Therefore, the change should be rejected. Please confirm if you agree so we coordinate a rejection.
I agree. 19 satisfies the limit, but 21 is greater than 20, so the requirement that every proposed value be <= 20 is not met. The change should be rejected. Let’s coordinate a rejection.

task.requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit.
